- Crafting table : 6 x Beryllium Nugget.
- Crafting table (x3) : 2 x [[gv:ingot_beryllium|Beryllium Ingot]].

Used to make :
[[gv:ingot_beryllium|Beryllium Ingot]], [[gv:nugget_beryllium|Beryllium Nugget]], [[gv:billet_po210be|Po210Be Billet]], [[gv:billet_pu238be|Pu238Be Billet]], [[gv:billet_ra226be|Ra226Be Billet]], [[gv:billet_schrabidium_fuel|Schrabidium Fuel Billet]].
